sections.heading: 已有基准与本文定位的差别
sections.body:
论文把已有工作分成三类。第一类是通用跨视频基准，如 CrossVid 与 MVU-Eval，评测视频集合的联合理解，但领域不是电商广告。第二类是广告理解基准，如 MM-AU、VideoAds、AdsQA，多数按单视频评测。第三类是电商广告基准，如 E-VAds，同样以单视频为主。下表按领域、规模、视频数量、任务格式以及是否显式覆盖时序与意图进行对照，用于说明 AdsCVR 在“电商 + 多视频 + 时序与意图”这一组合上的位置。比较时需注意各基准的任务格式不同（选择题、开放式、分割、分类），规模差异也不代表难度差异，因此表中数字只反映覆盖范围而非同条件下的性能高低。

| Benchmark | Domain | #Videos | #QA | Video Count | Task format | Temporal | Intent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MVU-Eval (Peng et al., 2025) | General | 4,959 | 1,824 | Multiple | MCQ | ✓ | — |
| CrossVid (Li et al., 2026) | General | 5,331 | 9,015 | Multiple | MCQ / Open | ✓ | — |
| Tencent-AVS (Wang et al., 2021) | Ads | 12,000 | N/A | Single | Seg. + Cls. | ✓ | — |
| MM-AU (Bose et al., 2023) | Ads | 8,399 | N/A | Single | Cls. | ✓ | ✓ |
| VideoAds (Zhang et al., 2025) | Ads | 200 | 1,100 | Single | MCQ | ✓ | ✓ |
| AdsQA (Long et al., 2025) | Ads | 1,544 | 7,859 | Single | Open | — | ✓ |
| E-VAds (Liu et al., 2026) | E-commerce | 3,961 | 19,785 | Single | Open | — | ✓ |
| AdsCVR | E-commerce | 2,483 | 6,110 | Multiple | MCQ | ✓ | ✓ |

从表中可见，MVU-Eval 与 CrossVid 属于通用领域且视频数量为多视频，但 Intent 一列为“—”；Tencent-AVS、MM-AU、VideoAds、AdsQA 属于广告领域且均为单视频；E-VAds 属于电商领域但同样为单视频；AdsCVR 是表中唯一同时满足电商领域、多视频、MCQ 任务格式且 Temporal 与 Intent 均被显式覆盖的基准。这一对照说明 AdsCVR 填补的是“电商 + 多视频 + 时序与意图”三者组合上的空白，但表中数字仅反映覆盖范围，不代表同条件下的性能高低。

sections.heading: 训练数据与动作空间消融
sections.body:
下表回答两个问题：训练数据的领域匹配是否重要，以及视觉与语音工具是否需要同时保留。比较在同一 3,000 题测试划分上进行，指标为准确率，Average 为六维度无权平均；MVU-Eval-only 与受限动作变体评测时无法解析的答案计为错误。

| Variant | TS | CS | ID | IC | OD | VC | Average |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Training data |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| In-domain only (AdsCVR) | 75.0 | 74.4 | 70.6 | 72.8 | 74.6 | 74.0 | 73.57 |
| MVU-Eval only | 67.4 | 60.8 | 60.8 | 63.6 | 65.6 | 66.2 | 64.07 |
| Mixed | 77.0 | 73.4 | 70.8 | 75.6 | 74.8 | 74.2 | 74.30 |
| Action space |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| frame_select only | 66.2 | 63.8 | 61.2 | 63.8 | 65.8 | 63.0 | 63.97 |
| audio_select only | 67.4 | 65.6 | 65.6 | 58.2 | 66.2 | 67.2 | 65.03 |
| AdSeek | 77.0 | 73.4 | 70.8 | 75.6 | 74.8 | 74.2 | 74.30 |

训练数据方面，仅用 AdsCVR 训练平均 73.57%，仅用 MVU-Eval 训练 64.07%，域内数据高出 9.50 个百分点；混合数据（AdsCVR 加 MVU-Eval 视频与脚本模拟的 AgentCVR 样例）为 74.30%，增益集中在 IC（+2.8）与 TS（+2.0），而 CS 下降 1.0 个百分点，说明混合来源并非在所有维度都有利。动作空间方面，只保留 frame_select 平均 63.97%，只保留 audio_select 平均 65.03%，相对完整模型分别下降 10.33 与 9.27 个百分点；视觉单独访问在 IC 上更好（63.8 对 58.2），语音单独访问在其余五个维度更好，完整模型在全部六个维度上都超过两个受限变体。这些结果支持视觉与语音证据互补，但消融只在 AdsCVR 测试划分上进行，未在 CrossVid 上重复，因此“互补”结论的适用范围限于该基准。

sourceQuotes: Beyond single videos, benchmarks like CrossVid (Li et al., 2026), MVU-Eval (Peng et al., 2025), and CVBench (Zhu et al., 2025) evaluate joint understanding of video collections, requiring models to aggregate distributed evidence and compare entities across videos.

However, existing advertising benchmarks such as MM-AU, AdsQA, and E-VAds (Bose et al., 2023; Long et al., 2025; Liu et al., 2026) predominantly focus on single-video understanding and do not adequately capture this practical need or the challenges of identifying key differences across videos.

Unlike general-domain CVR benchmarks such as CrossVid and MVU-Eval (Li et al., 2026; Peng et al., 2025), AdsCVR focuses on commercial reasoning over advertisements, where decisive evidence is scattered across videos, non-contiguous temporal intervals, and visual and audio modalities amid distracting dense content.

We introduce AdsCVR, an e-commerce cross-video reasoning benchmark comprising 2,483 videos and 6,110 QA pairs spanning 86 product categories (see Table 1 for a comparison). It evaluates models’ understanding of complex commercial analysis and their ability to identify fine-grained differences across information-dense videos.

Table 1: Comparison of video understanding benchmarks. Temporal and Intent denote explicit temporal and intent understanding coverage (✓\checkmark); —: not explicitly targeted. MCQ: multiple-choice QA; Open: open-ended QA; Seg.: segmentation; Cls.: classification.
MVU-Eval (Peng et al., 2025) General 4,959 1,824 Multiple MCQ ✓\checkmark —
CrossVid (Li et al., 2026) General 5,331 9,015 Multiple MCQ / Open ✓\checkmark —
Tencent-AVS (Wang et al., 2021) Ads 12,000 N/A Single Seg. + Cls. ✓\checkmark —
MM-AU (Bose et al., 2023) Ads 8,399 N/A Single Cls. ✓\checkmark ✓\checkmark
VideoAds (Zhang et al., 2025) Ads 200 1,100 Single MCQ ✓\checkmark ✓\checkmark
AdsQA (Long et al., 2025) Ads 1,544 7,859 Single Open — ✓\checkmark
E-VAds (Liu et al., 2026) E-commerce 3,961 19,785 Single Open — ✓\checkmark
AdsCVR E-commerce 2,483 6,110 Multiple MCQ ✓\checkmark ✓\checkmark

Table 5: Training-data and action-space ablations on AdsCVR test accuracy (%). Average denotes the unweighted mean across dimensions. MVU-Eval-only and restricted-action variants are evaluated on the 3,000-question test split, with unparsed answers counted as incorrect.
Table 5 shows that AdsCVR-only training outperforms MVU-Eval-only training by 9.50 percentage points (73.57% vs. 64.07%), supporting the value of domain-specific data for e-commerce video comparison.

Our mixed-source dataset, AdSeek-train, supplements AdsCVR with MVU-Eval videos and script-simulated AgentCVR examples, further improving accuracy to 74.30%. The additional gains are concentrated in IC (+2.8 points) and TS (+2.0 points), while CS decreases by 1.0 point.
Restricting AdSeek to frame_select or audio_select reduces average accuracy to 63.97% and 65.03%, respectively, corresponding to drops of 10.33 and 9.27 points from the full model.
The two modalities exhibit different strengths: visual-only access performs better on IC (63.8% vs. 58.2%), whereas speech-only access performs better on the other five dimensions.
